cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
